falsification: Reject the change if the target evidence does not improve, cannot be reproduced, or causes a verified regression in another dimension.
hypothesis: A focused reversible test can produce evidence about adaptation.
measurement: Compare the target dimension and its raw evidence before and after the test. Do not treat code changes alone as improvement.
method: Propose one code or policy change on a branch and compare it to the current baseline.
title: Test a reversible self-change.
